atha kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā rasapathaviṃ paribhuñjantā tabbhakkhā tadāhārā ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

29998.meaning1: (vinaya) belonging to that class; connected with that category (of offences or issues)
29998.commentary: (VINa) yasmā pana āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ āpatt'ādhikaraṇassa sabhāgavisabhāgavatthuto sabhāgasarikkh'āsarikkhato ca ek'aṃsena tabbhāgiyaṃ na hoti, tasmā āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ āpatt'ādhikaraṇassa siyā tabbhāgiyaṃ siyā aññabhāgiyan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: anuvād'ādhikaraṇaṃ anuvād'ādhikaraṇassa tabbhāgiyaṃ. āpatt'ādhikaraṇaṃ āpatt'ādhikaraṇassa siyā tabbhāgiyaṃ siyā aññabhāgiyaṃ.
